healthcare-associated infections hais falls and pressure ulcers this study describ the implementation of evidence-based strategi to improve safety in an oncology icu focusing on the prevention of clinical reviews checklists and systematic delirium measurement using the cam-icu scale results delirium rates remained below 20 with an average incidence of 10 healthcare-associated infections hais such as ventilator-associated pneumonia vap and catheter-related bloodstream infections crbsi remain within institutional targets the rate of preventable falls was close to zero and pressure ulcers showed progressive reduction after initial peaks conclusion implementing evidence-based strategi including adherence to safety polici multidisciplinary clinical reviews and the use of checklists effectively reduced adverse events in an oncology intensive care unit icu these findings highlight the importance of multifaceted approach to improving safety and quality of care in critically ill
